Attachment-6: Constructability Review 2 DE-FE0031937 / 0007 1.0 Background Dastur International Inc. has designed and engineered a solution that maximizes the decarbonization of available BF gas by capturing up to 2.8 million tonnes per annum (mtpa) of carbon dioxide (CO ) emissions 2 from blast furnaces (BFs) at Cleveland-Cliffs’ 5-million tonnes/year steel production plant in Burns Harbor, Indiana.
